    if (!mm) {
        a.remove();
        continue;

    var cid = String(mm[1]);

    if (nm === undefined) {
        nm = '第' + ((pageNo - 1) * 60 + i + 1) + '章';
    } else {
        nm = unesc(nm);

    }

ruleContent.content:
<js>var BASE = 'https://www.yi16.com';
function unesc(s) {
    return String(s).replace(/\\A\s?/g, '\n').replace(/\\'/g, "'").replace(/\\\\/g, '\\');
}
function extract(h) {
    var re = /#htmlContent\s+\.p_(\d+)::after\s*\{\s*content:'((?:[^'\\]|\\.)*)'\s*\}/g;
    var map = {};
    var m;
    while ((m = re.exec(h)) !== null) {
        map[String(m[1])] = String(m[2]);
    }
    var idx = [];
    for (var k in map) {
        idx.push(parseInt(k, 10));
    }
    idx.sort(function (x, y) { return x - y; });
    var ps = [];
    for (var i = 0; i < idx.length; i++) {
        var s = unesc(map[idx[i]]);
        if (s.replace(/\s/g, '').length > 0) ps.push(s);
    }
    return ps.join('\n');
}
var cur = String(baseUrl);
var parts = [];
var guard = 0;
while (cur && guard < 6) {
    var h = '';
    try {
        h = String(java.ajax(cur + ',{"headers":{"Referer":"' + BASE + '/"}}'));
    } catch (e) {
        break;
    }
    var t = extract(h);
    if (t.length > 0) parts.push(t);
    var m = h.match(/id="linkNext"[^>]*href="([^"]+)"[^>]*>([\s\S]*?)<\/a>/);
    if (!m) break;
    if (String(m[2]).indexOf('下一页') < 0) break;
    var nxt = String(m[1]);
    if (nxt.indexOf('http') === 0) {
        cur = nxt;
    } else if (nxt.charAt(0) === '/') {
        cur = BASE + nxt;
    } else {
        cur = cur.substring(0, cur.lastIndexOf('/') + 1) + nxt;
    }
    guard++;
}
var out = parts.join('\n').replace(/\n{3,}/g, '\n\n');
out;</js>
